The exception accepts no performance result and waives no required TreeDB gate, correctness/lifetime/durability finding, review or A/C/D outcome gate.

Root integrated its 56 changed production inputs and incorporated the already-reviewed nine-file #5072 mutation harness into [#5071](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/pull/5071), candidate `ebe414b6d6a22a7f616c108157a01f8ed109e7cc`. This graph reassessment gives A/C/D one reviewed landing and avoids a second serial strict-base integration/CI cycle. #5072 stays open as incorporation-pending and will close only after the combined code actually lands; #5059 cost remains open until accepted fresh measurements.

Raw original source identities and initial failures remain intact; this is focused correctness, not retained performance acceptance.

The first combined candidate `ebe414` passed hosted review and the auxiliary M0 run, but required Windows CI failed the COW lifetime fixture denial assertion. Static review found that optional periodic maintenance can clear its refresh gate; the original Windows worker schedule remains untraced. The failure is preserved. The repaired fixture disables optional generation at construction, pins the original three lanes and retains every explicit pressure/capture/install/retry assertion. Its hosted review was CLEAN and the repaired Windows lifetime job passed all five rows. Its auxiliary M0 run also passed. Required CI subsequently failed the unchanged main public COW power-loss fixture's before-meta-sync error classification; the original failure remains preserved. Earlier source labels remain original.

Current clean candidate **`aa8614ea79c63b21ca9a04580ace7f77a90b7f1b`** fixes that narrow classification gap: all three actual cuts after a meta write may return the asynchronous recovery sentinel, conditioned on captured ResourceMeta. Every other injected-cause and stable-image/group/durable-ACK/NoWAL oracle remains. Exact whole-fixture normal and race runs pass 37 rows each (10.635s/36.110s), plus root TreeDB vet/format and all 36 affected Python checks. Independent review is CLEAN; all 1,122 runtime inputs and A/C/D harness inputs remain unchanged. Current-head required CI is run37519676816 and one exact-head hosted review is requested. The superseded failed run was cancelled to release capacity, with original logs/results intact. No required-CI waiver applies.

Cleanup removed 11 exact released worktrees without force while preserving their commits/refs and active/unrelated work. Observed free-space recovery was2.36GiB, separate from the2.35GiB size estimate.

No current landing or fresh retained capture is claimed. Supported workload limits, generic replacement versus partial setter limits, finite lifecycle retention and external owners remain explicit.
